blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Память о ___ (холокост) эксплуатируют с политическими целями.
exercises.prompt: The memory of the Holocaust is abused for political purposes.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.
